title: A clearer App Store preview
summary: Version 1.3.1 refreshes the App Store presentation so it accurately shows the simpler Today, Journey, and Coach experience already introduced in Version 1.3.
appStoreNotes: Updated App Store screenshots now show the focused Today loop, the Day complete moment, Your Story and milestones in Journey, and the simpler Coach home.
The App Store description now explains the current identity-first experience in clearer language.
The in-app experience is unchanged from Version 1.3.

highlights.title: The current experience, accurately shown
highlights.description: The App Store presentation now matches the simplified daily loop already available in Version 1.3.
highlights.availability: There are no feature or pricing changes in this metadata refresh.

title: A simpler daily loop
summary: Version 1.3 brings Resolution Companion back to one clear loop: act today, see the evidence, and ask Coach for help when you need it.
appStoreNotes: Today is focused on your identity, today’s progress, and the actions directly in front of you.
Journey now brings notes, milestones, comebacks, and monthly chapters together in one Your Story destination.
Coach opens with one clear conversation choice plus quick ways to review your week or adjust your plan.
Trusted Witness settings now live in Profile, with every share still initiated by you.
Includes performance, accessibility, and reliability improvements.

highlights.title: Today, without the noise
highlights.description: The Today tab now centers the identity you are building, one daily completion ring, your scheduled actions, and a single completion moment.
highlights.availability: The focused daily loop is available to everyone.

highlights.title: One place for your story
highlights.description: Journey combines notes, milestones, comebacks, and monthly chapters in Your Story while keeping the calendar and milestone plan close by.
highlights.availability: Your Story is built from data stored on your device.

highlights.title: Ask Coach for what you need
highlights.description: Start one open conversation, review your week, or preview a small plan adjustment from a simpler Coach home.
highlights.availability: Weekly reviews remain free. The existing monthly conversation allowance and Premium limits are unchanged.

highlights.title: Sharing stays a choice
highlights.description: Trusted Witness now lives with your settings in Profile instead of competing with your progress story.
highlights.availability: Nothing is shared automatically; every message still uses the system share sheet you initiate.

title: Your evidence, your way
summary: Version 1.2 turns everyday votes into a private personal story and adds an optional, confirmation-first way to tune a plan without sending notes or event history.
appStoreNotes: A clearer Today’s Votes board and optional Daily Context make the daily loop faster and more useful.
Story Archive keeps every Month in Votes, while Evidence Timeline gathers meaningful notes, milestones, comebacks, and plan changes.
What Helps You Show Up finds careful on-device associations after enough context-tagged days.
Plan Tune-Up can review bounded 28-day aggregate counts, preview a small adjustment, and applies nothing until you confirm.
Daily notes, context note text, IDs, and individual event dates are never sent in a Plan Tune-Up.

highlights.title: Today’s votes, at a glance
highlights.description: Scheduled actions now form a compact voting board with the anchor and two-minute version still close at hand.
highlights.availability: The daily loop and optional Daily Context are free. Context is saved locally and can be backfilled for the prior seven days.

highlights.title: A story that stays yours
highlights.description: Story Archive preserves every Month in Votes. Evidence Timeline gathers context, action notes, milestones, comebacks, monthly stories, and confirmed plan adjustments without turning routine completions into a social feed.
highlights.availability: Both personal-history views are free and built from data stored on your device.

highlights.title: Patterns with patience
highlights.description: What Helps You Show Up compares context-tagged scheduled days and describes up to three useful associations without claiming cause.
highlights.availability: Patterns are computed on device only after at least 14 tagged scheduled days and enough comparison evidence.

highlights.title: A plan that can bend
highlights.description: Plan Tune-Up asks Coach for a small schedule, anchor, or kickstart adjustment based on a bounded trailing 28-day aggregate.
highlights.availability: You see a field-by-field preview first. Cancel, timeout, or invalid output leaves the current plan unchanged.

highlights.title: A clear AI privacy boundary
highlights.description: Tune-Up requests exclude daily notes, context note text, local IDs, and individual event dates. The app shares only current action settings and aggregate counts after AI consent.
highlights.availability: The privacy disclosure appears before the first AI request and can be turned off later in Profile.

title: More ways to keep moving
summary: Version 1.1 makes the daily loop faster, more personal, and easier to carry with you while keeping the app's price unchanged.
appStoreNotes: Coach openings now stream smoothly, matching the onboarding conversation.
Faster, more reliable coaching and plan creation.
Personalized reminders reflect your goals and unfinished daily actions.
Clearer Premium subscription status and plan details.

highlights.title: Coaching without the wait
highlights.description: Coach openings appear immediately and replies stream into the conversation, grounded in your active identity and progress.
highlights.availability: Ten check-ins each month are free; Premium adds unlimited coaching and memory across sessions.

highlights.title: A reminder that knows the next step
highlights.description: After you allow notifications, one daily reminder can name your goal or unfinished action, skip rest days, and stay quiet once you finish.
highlights.availability: Choose the time that fits your routine or turn reminders off at any time.

highlights.title: Cast votes beyond the app
highlights.description: Log progress from Home and Lock Screen widgets, Siri, or optional Apple Health matches for workouts, steps, and mindful minutes.
highlights.availability: Health matching is opt-in per action, and Health data stays on your device.

highlights.title: Progress that tells a story
highlights.description: Month in Votes recaps turn your history into a share-ready story. Premium Journey insights surface patterns and useful next steps.
highlights.availability: Your personal history is analyzed locally on your device.

highlights.title: Grace when life happens
highlights.description: Seven clean action-days earn a shield that can protect your streak from a miss. Every action can still have a 120-Second Kickstart for busy days.
highlights.availability: Free holds one earned shield; Premium can hold two.

highlights.title: Private and in your control
highlights.description: Opt in to a private iCloud backup, or celebrate progress with Someone in Your Corner through a share you initiate yourself.
highlights.availability: No Resolution Companion account is required.

media.title: See the adaptive AI Coach in action
media.description: A short demonstration of coaching that remembers the plan, reflects progress, and helps adjust the next step.
transcript: I gave an AI coach my goals for a month. I went in a skeptic.
It coaches; it does not lecture. A bad week adjusts the plan.
A coach in your corner follows up on what you said.
Resolution Companion. Any day can be day one. Free to start on the App Store.
